summary: ITER45 backend-only smoke + regression after the core/helpers.py ImportError fix (expirar_bloqueos_pass) and the introduction of ACID guards in MP/Stripe webhooks + core/transactions.py + mercadopago_service.refundar_pago. 16/16 pytest cases PASS against the public preview URL. The backend boots clean, GET /api/ returns 200, admin login (admin@padelappretas.com / admin123) works, GET /api/public/retas/buscar returns a list, the cron endpoint POST /api/retas/{reta_id}/expirar-pendientes returns {ok, eliminadas, promovidos, retas_afectadas} with proper auth gating and 404 on unknown reta, the jobs worker logs '[jobs] worker loop iniciado · tick=10s' on startup (confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log), MongoDB is reachable for jobs_queue, GET /api/admin/payouts/summary and GET /api/admin/comunidad/asistencia both return 200 with admin auth, and direct-call promover_lista_espera('non-existent') returns None gracefully (idempotent). The new modules core/transactions.safe_transaction and mercadopago_service.refundar_pago are importable and exposed. ACID guard code verified present in routers/mercadopago.py:_aplicar_resultado_pago (lock_actual + cupos_solicitados > max_jugadores check at line 425, refund call at line 578, safe_transaction at line 694) and routers/payments_router.py (max_jug check at line 245, refundar_pago at line 184, safe_transaction at line 279). No real MP/Stripe webhook fired (no live credentials needed per request — flagged as `requires-external`). Standalone Mongo confirmed: safe_transaction will degrade to no-tx mode per design (transactions cache log will emit `[tx] capability detected · replica=False sharded=False → tx=False` on first use).

minor.issue: On every backend restart, passlib emits `(trapped) error reading bcrypt version · AttributeError: module 'bcrypt' has no attribute '__about__'`. Harmless (passlib falls back) but noisy in stderr. Fix: pin `bcrypt<4` or upgrade passlib. Cosmetic only.

STILL OPEN from iter44: q with embedded NUL byte returns 500. Not retested here (out of scope), but the regression test is in test_iter44_chaos_destructive.py — main agent should still fix routers/public.py:48 to strip ASCII control chars before re.escape.

If desired, main agent can ask for a unit test that monkeypatches mercadopago_service.refundar_pago and posts a forged /webhook/mp payload with overflow inscritos_lock.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ core/helpers.py: expirar_bloqueos_pass and handle_waitlist_pending_timeout are now distinct top-level coroutines; the import in routers/retas.py works cleanly.

✅ POST /api/retas/{reta_id}/expirar-pendientes is admin-gated, returns 404 for unknown reta, and returns {ok, eliminadas, promovidos, retas_afectadas} for valid reta. Idempotent (2nd call still ok=True).
✅ core/transactions.safe_transaction implements graceful fallback for standalone Mongo (yields None when no replica set / sharded cluster detected).

✅ routers/mercadopago.py:_aplicar_resultado_pago enforces `lock_actual + cupos_solicitados > max_jugadores` guard BEFORE approving and emits refund via `mps.refundar_pago` when overflow detected (line 425/578); wraps the critical section in `async with safe_transaction() as session:` (line 694).
✅ routers/payments_router.py mirrors the same guard pattern and calls `payments_stripe.refundar_pago` on overflow.
✅ mercadopago_service.refundar_pago is defined (line 140) and exported (test_mercadopago_refundar_pago_present PASS).
✅ Jobs worker is MongoDB-backed (no Redis), logs `[jobs] worker loop iniciado · tick=10s` every supervisor restart (verified in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log).
✅ promover_lista_espera returns None without raising when waitlist is empty (idempotent — verified via direct asyncio.run call).

ℹ️ Backend is currently running on Mongo standalone — `safe_transaction` will degrade to no-tx; this is by design but means rollback semantics will not apply on multi-document failures. Production deployment SHOULD use a replica set for the ACID guarantees to be strict.

rca_of_issue: Original break (ImportError on `from core.helpers import expirar_bloqueos_pass`) is FULLY RESOLVED. Verified via test_helpers_imports_clean (importlib + inspect.iscoroutinefunction) and via the live POST /api/retas/{id}/expirar-pendientes returning 200 with the expected shape. The fix correctly separates `handle_waitlist_pending_timeout` (handles ONE expired pending inscription, called by the jobs worker) from `expirar_bloqueos_pass` (sweeps ALL expired inscriptions or all pending in a single reta when force_reta_id is passed, called by both the admin button and the periodic cron). Both are top-level async coroutines now; previously the body of expirar_bloqueos_pass was nested inside handle_waitlist_pending_timeout as dead code, which is why `from core.helpers import expirar_bloqueos_pass` failed at module import time and crashed the backend boot.
